snippet.title: ROCKBEASTS Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Manage a dysfunctional band on its rise to fame in the age of MTV. Written by a narrative veteran behind The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077, this story-driven RPG puts you in the role of a band manager, blending tough decisions, dark comedy, memorable characters, and a striking animated visual style.

#TheIndiePremier #GameShowcase #IndieGames #ROCKBEASTS
